CustomField.label: Is Synthetic
CustomField.description: True only for demo/synthetic records inserted by scripts/seed-synthetic-data.py (issue synthetic-seed-data). This is the authoritative, queryable flag the script's --teardown mode filters on -- every delete it issues is scoped to WHERE Is_Synthetic__c = true, never unfiltered. Paired with a human-readable [DEMO] prefix on this record's name/title field as a visual-inspection backstop, but this flag -- not the prefix -- is what teardown actually queries. Internal/admin housekeeping field: never surfaced on rep- or content-editor-facing layouts.
